treemap.comment: Read treemap-beta or treemap as the lowercase header without adding a suffix-boundary test. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and treemap.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows treemap.md#comments-and-authored-boundaries.
Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows treemap.md#common-forms.

Read a classDef composite through its class name and optional whitespace-led style, preserving those positions across lines. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

Read the class name and its whitespace-led style, recognizing property names and whole values while retaining other accepted style text. The name starts at the composite's scan position or after a continued gap. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions and common.md#comment-lines.
Keep style entities whole while leaving a final CSS hex color's semicolon available as a displayed separator. Follows treemap.md#comments-and-authored-boundaries and common.md#entities.
patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a styleless class name and its optional final semicolon without a value scope. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions.

Read the selector marker and its class element name across hidden newlines, retaining directives and common comments between them. Follows treemap.md#names-numbers-and-strings, treemap.md#headers-and-indentation, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
Read plain double-quoted row labels. Follows treemap.md#names-numbers-and-strings.
Read plain single-quoted row labels. Follows treemap.md#names-numbers-and-strings.
Read a numeric leaf value, keeping its commas and underscores whole after its first digit or dot. Follows treemap.md#names-numbers-and-strings.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read either leaf value separator. Follows treemap.md#grammar.

treemap-style.comment: Color property pairs inside the document's opaque style text for the reader, separating them at commas while preserving spaces and further colons within each value. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions.

treemap-style-text.comment: Read style separators and accepted opaque text outside a property pair. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions.

patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.comma.mermaid
patterns.comment: Color commas between displayed properties or bare style text as separators, although the document reads one opaque style-text unit. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions.

patterns.name: string.unquoted.mermaid
patterns.comment: Read an unquoted style-text run outside a property pair, stopping before whitespace, a comma, a semicolon or a common-comment boundary. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions and common.md#comment-lines.

treemap-line-final-keywords.comment: Read accDescr at a unit position when its physical line has only trailing whitespace and directives. The delimiter and value on later lines stay with their surrounding rules. Follows treemap.md#common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.

treemap-class-definition-gap.comment: Read the remaining whitespace before a class name or style, continuing over empty lines and removed common comments. The begin takes its line to the end so that the next line remains in this composite; the first non-whitespace character ends the gap after directives and comments have been read. Follows treemap.md#class-definitions, common.md#comment-lines, and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
